spans.text: Also act as the process owner and use your expertise and familiarity with the process context to fill in any missing knowledge.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the system to 'act as the process owner and use your expertise and familiarity with the process context to fill in any missing knowledge.' This encourages the system to fabricate domain knowledge it doesn't actually possess, potentially generating plausible but incorrect process details rather than acknowledging uncertainty.
